recipes.oracle_text: {4}: Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.

recipe_coverage: Single-card library tutor through actual casting, creature entry, or permanent activation. Oracle-pinned mixed witnesses exercise type unions/intersections, subtypes and changelings, colors, legendary status, fixed mana/power/toughness limits, named cards, exact costs, destination receipts, populated zones, duplicate/two-source/repeat searches, both controllers and snapshots where applicable. Source entry components also test removal, bounce/recast and blink. Selector observations check eligibility and required/optional finding. Source keyword abilities, other activated abilities, fetched Aura attachment, additional triggers, replacement effects, multiplayer and shuffle distribution remain separate gaps.
